description: SandroGT Spider4SPARQL processed dev questions for battle_death. Gold answers are populated from the RDF graph.

questions.nl_question: How many ships ended up being 'Captured'?

questions.gold_sparql: select ?t1_name ?t1_tonnage where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/tonnage> ?t1_tonnage . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . } order by desc (?t1_name)

What is the average number of injuries caused each time?

questions.gold_sparql: select distinct ?t1_id ?t1_name where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-lost_in_battle> ?t1 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ship_type> ?t2_ship_type . FILTER(?t2_ship_type = 'Brig') . }
questions.nl_question: What are the different ids and names of the battles that lost any 'Brig' type shipes?

questions.gold_sparql: select ?t1_id ?t1_name where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-lost_in_battle> ?t1 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/killed> ?t3_killed . ?t3 a <http://valuenet/ontop/death> . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-caused_by_ship> ?t2 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/killed> ?t3_killed . } group by ?t1_id ?t1_name having(sum( ?t3_killed) > 10)
questions.nl_question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.

questions.gold_sparql: SELECT ?T1_id (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?T2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/death> . ?T2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-caused_by_ship> ?T1 . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?T1_id . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?T1_name . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?T1_id . } GROUP BY ?T1_id ?T1_name ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1

questions.gold_sparql: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . Filter not exists {{select ?t22_lost_in_battle where { ?t22 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t22 <http://valuenet/ontop/lost_in_battle> ?t22_lost_in_battle . ?t22 <http://valuenet/ontop/tonnage> ?t22_tonnage . FILTER(?t22_tonnage = '225') . } } FILTER (?t1_id in (?t22_lost_in_battle))} }
questions.nl_question: How many battles did not lose any ship with tonnage '225'?

questions.gold_sparql: select distinct ?t1_name ?t1_date where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-lost_in_battle> ?t1 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/date> ?t1_date . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t2_name . FILTER(?t2_name = 'Lettice') . FILTER (?t1_name in (?t3_name)) . FILTER (?t1_date in (?t3_date)) . ?t3 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t4 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t4 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-lost_in_battle> ?t3 . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t3_name . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/date> ?t3_date . ?t4 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t4_name . FILTER(?t4_name = 'HMS Atalanta') . }
questions.nl_question: List the name and date the battle that has lost the ship named 'Lettice' and the ship named 'HMS Atalanta'

questions.gold_sparql: SELECT distinct?col1?col2?col3 WHERE { { select (?t1_name as ?col1) (?t1_result as ?col2) (?t1_bulgarian_commander as ?col3) where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/result> ?t1_result . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/bulgarian_commander> ?t1_bulgarian_commander . }} MINUS {select (?t2_name as ?col1) (?t2_result as ?col2) (?t2_bulgarian_commander as ?col3) where { ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/battle> . ?t3 a <http://valuenet/ontop/ship> . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-lost_in_battle> ?t2 . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t2_name . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/result> ?t2_result . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/bulgarian_commander> ?t2_bulgarian_commander . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/location> ?t3_location . FILTER(?t3_location = 'English Channel') . } } }
